name: ConnectX
tagline: The contact center with an AI agent inside.
description: IP telephony, AI voice agents, omnichannel routing and agent workspaces with supervisor tools, recording, reporting and workforce management.
overview: ConnectX brings IP telephony, self-service, routing and agent operations into one contact-center platform. An AI voice agent handles supported questions using approved content and connected systems, with identity checks and a contextual handoff when a person is needed. Agents work across voice, chat, email, WhatsApp and social channels, while supervisors review recordings, quality scores, queues and workforce performance. Customer-managed deployment supports existing IP handsets and integration with banking, CRM and operational systems.
aiEdge: AI supports voice conversations, knowledge-based answers, transcription, quality scoring and workforce forecasting. Identity policies and approved sources govern responses; sensitive operations are handed to a human. Connect your own Claude or Gemini API key in Settings and pay your provider directly.

features.title: AI Virtual Agent
features.text: Answer supported voice and chat questions from approved sources, apply identity policies and hand off to an agent with conversation context.

features.title: IVR & Self-Service
features.text: Design menus visually, collect masked sensitive inputs and connect supported self-service operations to authorized business systems.

features.title: ACD & Routing
features.text: Route by agent skills and priority, announce wait times and offer callbacks or queue overflow when the right agent is unavailable.

features.title: Agent Desktop & CTI
features.text: Handle voice, chat, email and social in one browser workspace with customer context, a WebRTC softphone and wrap-up reason codes.

features.title: Supervisor & Quality
features.text: Listen, whisper or join live calls, review synchronized voice and screen recordings and use transcription and AI-assisted quality scoring.

features.title: Omnichannel & Knowledge
features.text: Bring phone, web chat, WhatsApp, email and social into a universal queue with customer history, suggested knowledge and CRM synchronization.

features.title: Reporting & Wallboards
features.text: Review service levels and drill into individual calls, display browser wallboards and prepare scheduled reporting and Power BI connections.

features.title: Workforce & Dialer
features.text: Forecast demand, prepare rosters and monitor adherence while coordinating predictive, progressive and preview outbound campaigns.

features.title: Platform & Security
features.text: Support encrypted SIP telephony, customer-managed infrastructure, administrative MFA, role-based playback and an append-only AI audit trail.

workflow.title: Connect and configure
workflow.text: Connect authorized phone trunks and business systems, prepare approved knowledge and define identity, IVR and routing policies.

workflow.title: Answer and hand off
workflow.text: Let the AI agent handle supported questions, then route sensitive or unresolved requests to a skilled agent with full context.

workflow.title: Review and improve
workflow.text: Review recordings, quality scores, service levels and workforce adherence to refine customer service with human oversight.

evaluation: Bring your channel requirements, concurrent-agent count, approved telephony provider, identity policies and integration specifications. Confirm language coverage, deployment topology, retention, training and support terms during evaluation. No hosting region or certification is implied.
